invariants.rationale: The method always returns either fileId or the result of super.getFileIdPfx(partitionId), both of which are expected to be non-null to avoid downstream issues.
If fileId is not null, the method returns fileId, so result must equal fileId.
If fileId is null, the method returns super.getFileIdPfx(partitionId), which should not equal fileId (as fileId is null).
PartitionId may be any integer, but this covers mutually exclusive cases and respects the instructions not to create tautologies.
